name: Date range picker
summary: Pick a period: presets on the left, two months side by side, confirm with Apply. On mobile one month, with the presets as a row on top.
use: Filter by period in dashboards, reports and overviews.
avoid: Date of birth or another known date: use Date picker with openTo year, or Input.
anatomy: Field with a calendar icon and the chosen period.
Panel: presets, two Calendars (Calendar day: Range start, In range, Range end), footer with a summary, Cancel and Apply.
figmaProps: + Range start, Range end, In range
reactProps: { start: Date | null; end: Date | null }
Calendar: rangeStart, rangeEnd, onDayHover, month, onMonthChange, hidePrevious, hideNext
New Calendar props for ranges and linked months.
behaviour: First click = start, second click = end. If you click before the start, they swap.
While you pick, you see the range on hover or focus.
Cancel or Escape closes without a change. Focus goes back to the field. Tab out or a click outside also close without a change.
Inside a Modal, Escape closes only the panel. The panel opens in the top layer and stays inside the screen.
a11y: The field is a button with aria-haspopup="dialog". The panel is a dialog.
Calendar works with arrow keys, PageUp and PageDown. Days in the range have aria-selected.
Presets are buttons with aria-pressed. The summary is read out (aria-live).
content: Summary with the number of days: "Nov 23 – Dec 4, 2026 · 12 days".
do: Choose presets that fit the data.
dont: Filter straight away on the first click: wait for Apply.
open: You cannot type the start and end date yet, only pick them.
